item.title: BLM and NNCC Announce a Wild Horse and Burro Adoption Event for February 21, 2026
item.description: The Bureau of Land Management and the Nevada Department of Corrections (NNCC) – Silver State Industries have announced a saddle-started wild horse adoption event at the NNCC on Saturday, February 21, 2026. Up to 19 saddle-started wild horses and one wild burro trained by the NNCC inmates, will be offered for adoption. item.title: Montana Farm Bureau Supports Lower Yellowstone River Native Fish Conservation Act
item.description: The Montana Farm Bureau Federation has voiced its support of HR 6568, the Lower Yellowstone River Native Fish Conservation Act, which was heard yesterday in the House Natural Resources Committee. The bill, which was introduced by Representative Troy Downing, (R-MT), solidifies the responsibility of the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation to maintain the Lower Yellowstone Fish Bypass Channel. item.title: A Look Into the Markets – Cattle Markets Higher but Close Weak
item.description: The cattle markets showed early strength as both markets open higher on the day with the Feeder gap opening higher. The strength didn’t last as Feeders broke down, making an early low and closed the gap and Fats hovering near its opening lows. Confidence returned to the market and Fats surged, trading to the high of the day at 241.00.
